caller_context: Original top-level main-actor caller; both existing asynchronous wrappers already use the generic executor.
change: Only predecessor import and encode/decode calls change; normal verification, timing boundaries and preparation remain byte-identical.
linkage: Both original packages declare automatic library products without a dynamic type. Existing Benchmark otool -L lists no SwiftJLS/JPEGLS dynamic library: codec objects are statically linked. AsyncBaselineCore is an ordinary separately compiled target linked into the executable, with no forced dynamic product or inlining annotations.
measurement_scope: Added public async-call/frame/executor-boundary cost, including the module boundary. No claim of a thread hop per call, complete causal attribution, or performance waiver.
